Team / Sara — I reviewed the customer redlines and drafted suggested language below. This is intended to be a compromise — keeps Redwood’s overall exposure bounded while addressing GreenWave’s regulatory concerns and their brand protection needs. Please review and flag anything that impacts pricing or execution.

1) Liability cap (Order Form / MSA):
Proposed: "Except for liability arising from (a) willful misconduct or gross negligence, or (b) breach of Sections X (Confidentiality) or Y (Data Protection), each party's aggregate liability to the other for all claims arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (i) twelve (12) months of fees paid by Customer under the applicable Order Form in the 12 months preceding the claim; or (ii) USD 1,000,000. For customers who have executed an annual committed spend of at least USD 5,000,000, the parties may agree to a higher cap in the applicable Order Form."

2) Regulatory fines / third-party penalties carve-out:
Proposed: "Notwithstanding the foregoing, neither party shall be excluded from liability for damages arising from (a) fines or penalties imposed by a governmental authority to the extent resulting from a party's breach of applicable laws governing data protection, or (b) amounts due to third parties as a direct result of a party's gross negligence or willful misconduct."

3) Consequential damages:
Proposed: "Neither party shall be liable to the other for any special, incidental, consequential, exemplary or punitive damages, except to the extent such damages arise from (a) a party's gross negligence or willful misconduct, (b) a breach giving rise to indemnification obligations to third parties, or (c) amounts expressly carved out in Section 2 above (regulatory fines)."

4) Publicity / press releases and trademark misuse:
Proposed: "Neither party will issue any press release or public announcement referencing the other party's name, logos, trademarks or the existence or terms of this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding the foregoing, either party may include the other's name and logo in a customer list on its website so long as the usage complies with the trademark usage guidelines attached as Exhibit A. In the event of alleged trademark misuse or other unauthorized public use, the purportedly aggrieved party shall provide written notice and the other party shall, within five (5) business days, cease the disputed use and propose remedial steps; failure to cease or remediate shall be an irreparable harm permitting injunctive relief."

5) Trademark usage appendix (Exhibit A):
Proposed: short appendix with: (i) approved logo files and colors; (ii) do's and don'ts; (iii) requirement to submit any co-branded material to the customer's marketing contact for approval prior to publication; (iv) removal timeline of five (5) business days on written request.

Notes and trade-offs:
- The upward liability tier for customers with committed spend gives us commercial flexibility while preserving a clear default cap.
- The publicity clause is closely tied to brand safety; adding the Exhibit A removes ambiguity and limits follow-up negotiation on creative assets.
- Injunctive relief language for trademark misuse is standard for customers sensitive about brand control; we should expect GreenWave to push for broader pre-approval timelines on any public facing work.
